body.statement: For \(\mathbf P^{\mathrm{hyp}}=(H_d,\ldots,H_d)\), \(L(\mathbf P^{\mathrm{hyp}})=0\) when \(K\) is even and \(L(\mathbf P^{\mathrm{hyp}})=K^{-2}\) when \(K\) is odd. In particular, the legal \(K=3,d=5\) witness satisfies \(L(\mathbf P^{\mathrm{hyp}})=1/9\).
body.justification: Parity is a complete all-rematching certificate and a destructive check against treating vector joint mixability as automatic.
body.gap: The mixability literature studies selected scalar classes; the explicit vector hypercube law and its original second-moment endpoint are not supplied by those results.
body.consumer: The \(K=3,d=5\) instance provides an exact finite benchmark for every empirical MOT and dual-certificate implementation.
